game.name: F1 2014 (Brazil)(En,Pt)
game.desc: F1 2014 is a racing game available for Xbox 360. With the official licences of the 2014 Formula 1 World Championship, it also includes all its new features, starting with the V6 turbo engines, 8-speed gearboxes and the Spielberg and Sochi circuits. It is then possible to live your own career or to race alone or with up to 16 drivers online on one of the 19 circuits of the game.
